data.body:
Phase 1 confirmed RCA (before repair):

The heartbeat window contains two mechanisms. The persistent outage is a code defect: commit 557f8c16e35 introduced `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/runtime.py:39` with unconditional module-scope `from pydantic import SecretStr`, and commit 40b8ac8295 activated that module on every live pass through `reconcile.py:94-96`. The bridge deliberately runs `pip install .` without `[agents]` (`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, Install rebar), while `pyproject.toml:61-66` and `docs/config.md:44-52` define the engine/reconciler as stdlib-only and place pydantic only in the optional agents extra. Therefore three consecutive scheduled passes (32132211322, 32137600442, 32143243238) stop before config/network with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pydantic`.

Discriminating proof: a fresh local no-extras install had `find_spec("pydantic") is None` and reproduced the exact runtime.py:39 traceback. Installing only pydantic in that same venv made the runtime import succeed. Historical dynamic A/B probes with pydantic absent showed normal reconcile loading succeeds at 0f7461d243 (last-success head) and at 557f8c16e35 (runtime exists but is not activated), then fails at 40b8ac8295 at reconcile.py:94 -> runtime.py:39. This rules out Jira credentials, runner failure, packaging-path corruption, and a Pydantic API/version mismatch. Legitimacy: defect; it directly violates the cited stdlib-only reconciler contract and the workflow contract that reconcile needs no agents extra.

The first failed hour, run 32127284997 at head 4c3e5970e6, is separate: ACLI returned logical FAILURE editing REB-3162 (`Issue does not exist or you do not have permission`). A read-only `acli jira workitem view REB-3162` still returns the same visibility error. That environmental/shared-Jira mechanism is already tracked on open parentless bug `dutiable-shaded-honeyeater`; further confirmation would mutate Jira and remains awaiting explicit authorization. It does not explain the following three Pydantic failures.

Repair target for this ticket: restore the stdlib-only runtime while preserving StaticAuth credential masking/reveal behavior, and add a clean-core bridge/runtime oracle so this contract cannot pass CI unexercised.
